items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: But now before you had Peter and then you had my father-in-law there, Edmund Payton.

ctx.x: See, you were born in 96. Yes right. You were only about nine or ten years old, hardly ten years old. That's right.

That's right. And along that time, you take, Luriat was running, that's what the white place up there at the naval station, they were playing there. They had bands up there, you played there too Tom? Yeah, I played there. Yeah, Peter and Peter. But now before you had Peter and then you had my father-in-law there, Edmund Payton. Edmund Payton. Edmund Payton. So what did Payton play? He played bass and banjo, guitar.
Seems like I once heard something about Payton had an accordion band or something. Did he ever play accordion or did he have any?
